coordinates: Current lid arcs; x -0.18 to 1.30 inner-to-outer; distance from upper lid 0 to 0.46 or lower lid 0 to 0.30, in pose-adjusted eye widths
method: Locally illumination-normalized target/source optical density, smoothed and averaged across both eyes; brown multiply pigment with feathered alpha
excluded: Eyeball pixels, reference face geometry and full face texture
purpose: Local standalone makeup matching; not a face-likeness score
